name: Stacked glass bars
oneLiner: glass blocks drop onto 3 to 5 stacks and land with a squash, one tint per series and the chosen series in the accent, totals ride the top of each stack while the camera tracks the build; the last accent block slams down, rings out and its total pops
say: when the speaker breaks a total into parts that grow over time ('ideas, drafts and published posts, month by month'): cut in on the breakdown, the last accent block lands on the word that names the result
